key_points.text: Over the summer, I spent time with Abby Johnson.
key_points.evidence_quote: Over the summer, I spent time with Abby Johnson, who is the chairman and CEO Fidelity Investments and several other business leads at Fidelity to understand how a very large firm like theirs is navigating change in our industry.

thesis: The transcript discusses the increasing complexity of the asset management industry, noting that while individuals previously had limited choices between brokers and mutual funds, they now face a wide range of options including ETFs and derivatives. The speaker identifies fee pressure and regulatory change over the last decade as the two most significant trends requiring innovation, specifically through digital solutions to help mass affluent investors navigate this complicated landscape.
